# Phase 4: full-sweep time estimate (generated by `scripts/06_pilot_check.py`)

Pilot: 34 sweep units (`results/runs/sweep/*/*/*/unit_time.json`), n_train 10-640, unit wall time 11-232 s.
Model: log(seconds) = 2.17 + 0.42 log(n_train), fitted on the pilot units; 2 parallel workers; 5 seeds.
Large units (Adult full, bank full, calhousing full, jungle full) use the probe `results/P4_probe_large.json` instead (jungle full, n_train 28684: TabPFN 451 s for 73503 scored rows, 3.9 s per XGBoost fit, 183 fits per unit).

**Estimated full sweep: 7.2 hours** (all 97 dataset x size cells x seeds; of which 1.9 h sequential TabPFN scoring of the large units).
